name: dantofa-platform-cluster
description: dantofa platform cluster-ops for downstream projects: dctl + the CLI toolchain on PATH, and the cluster.just module + base .trivyignore materialized into ./.just for `import`. See https://github.com/dantofa/platform.

init_hook: for p in '.just/' '.claude/skills/dantofa-platform/' '.devbox/' '.claude/settings.local.json'; do grep -qxF "$p" .gitignore 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' "$p" >> .gitignore; done
